[non-codebase] LIVE VALIDATION — disposition: DEFERRED to operator edge-deploy (NON-BLOCKING)

This acceptance criterion is intentionally NOT satisfiable within this code-only change; it is
deferred to a separate operator edge-deploy. Recording the concrete disposition/reasoning that
ties this criterion to its (future, out-of-repo) evidence, per the completion-verifier's
non-codebase evidence path:

- Instrument: live-call — an unauthenticated HTTP probe of
  `https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/review/health/` on the DEPLOYED edge, observing the 307
  `Location` resolving to `.../review/health` (prefix retained).
- Why it cannot be satisfied here: this ticket's operator-approved scope (Option 1) is an EDGE
  nginx config change (`infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template`) plus structural tests. Landing/merging
  the config does NOT deploy it. The live probe can only run after the rendered config is applied
  to the edge box. Per the operator's explicit instruction for this work, this session must NOT
  deploy / ssm / reload / touch any AWS box.
- Gating: this live-validation is satisfied by the SAME operator edge-deploy that clears sibling
  a61d (enchanting-phantastic-weevil) AC5. That deploy is gated on bug 1d1b
  (downy-feminist-leopard, being fixed separately) plus an operator apply. When performed, the
  operator's edge probe of `/review/health/` will record the observed 307 `Location` with the
  `/review/` prefix retained; that live evidence attaches at deploy time, outside this code change.
- Code-side ACs (the two in-repo-verifiable criteria) ARE met and proven in the merged change:
  structural tests over the RENDERED nginx config prove (a) a `/review/<route>/` redirect
  `Location` retains the `/review/` prefix, and (b) the prefix-stripping REQUEST path
  (`GET /review/health` -> app `/health`) is unchanged; a61d's http->https scheme guarantee is
  preserved. See `tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py` and merged Gerrit change 2438
  (commit 4915f3651cd4, `rebar-ticket: 4d8c-c1f9-5ea4-454d`).

Disposition: this AC is DEFERRED-to-operator-deploy and NON-BLOCKING for closing the code fix.
The code fix is complete, reviewed (LLM-Review +1), CI-verified (Verified +1), and MERGED. The
close is classed `preexisting` with caused_by `786b-190d-5e3a-4194`.
